editorSaveFormatTitle: Which format should it be saved in?
editorSignedBody:
The signature covers the document as it was when it was signed; it cannot be carried over to a changed document.

• Save over it: the file is updated with your changes, without a signature. The signed version is kept in the document history; you can go back to it or take a copy of it whenever you like.

• Unsigned copy: the signed file stays as it is, and your changes are written to a new file.
editorChangedElsewhereBody: This file was changed in another program after you opened it here. If you save, your version is kept as the file; the other version is kept in the document history.
editorOverwriteSignedBody: The file is updated with your changes, without a signature. The signed version is kept in the document history.
